body:
Cassie Colby

Captain

I am a Senior at Piedmont High School and have been coding for about 8 years. In middle school I did FLL and FTC. After joining 8033, I led Lovat in my freshman and sophmore year. For the last 4 years I have mentored local FTC teams, and done strategy for the team. Additionally, this is my second year of drive coaching. I'm looking forward to a great season of improving our robot creation process and improving the community.

Vice Captains

Athena Li

Vice Captain of Software

I'm a senior at Piedmont High School and this will be my fourth year in FRC and my eighth in FIRST overall. Before vice captain, I was the software lead and training lead, and I really care about advancing our technical skillset while building sustainable infrastructure for the team. Additionally, I've presented for the Impact Award, mentored 2 FTC teams, volunteered at tournaments + outreach events, and designed merch. I'm excited to build our next robot and for a great season!

Sammy McClanahan

Vice Captain of Program Managment

I live in San Francisco, and I'm a junior at Lowell High School and this will be my 3rd year in FRC/FIRST and my 2nd with 8033. Prior to joining 8033, I was part of FRC 4159 CardinalBotics for one year. Before being Vice Captain, I was the head of strategy and a pit lead. I also mentor another FRC team, 10221 #1 Sea Bass in South SF. This year, I'm looking forward to helping to shape the robot design and coordinating a new group of students to have our best season yet.
